Featuring a fixed waistband with a drawcord for adjustability and button closure and zip fly at center front.
There are two front slash pockets for dropping in personal items, with a hidden zippered pocket in one, and two secure back zip pockets for securing your more important belongings.
Finished off with a cinch at the bottom for fit adjustments on the go and an Industrial Outerknown label at the back pocket.
C0 DWR (perfluorocarbon-free) water-resistance.
